status.description: "ok" for a normal round. "blocked" only when the manuscript cannot be made to build at all: the loop then stops rather than spending the remaining budget on a tree that does not compile. Required, so that leaving the tree buildable is a statement the result makes rather than a field it can omit.

build_blocker.description: Required with status "blocked": the file, the error, and why it cannot be fixed from here.

id.description: The audit or review issue id this closes.

reverified.description: True when a touched number was compared back to its source file.

needs.description: What has to exist before this can be fixed.

reason.description: The specific missing artifact, so the next round can target it.

clarified.description: The edit that stops the next reader making the same misreading.

incidental_changes.description: Edits no issue asked for. Listed so the reviewer can see how a revision can introduce new defects.

x-piano-assertions.message: compiles must be true: this stage is the last one that may leave the manuscript unbuildable. Fix the build, or report status "blocked" with a build_blocker naming the file and the error.
status "blocked" asserts that the manuscript cannot be built, so a blocked result must report compiles: false. A spurious block stops the loop and spends the rest of the budget doing nothing.

resolved.change: Replaced the 2.3x geomean in §1 ¶4 with 1.64x, and removed the same figure from the abstract, which stated it a second time.
Narrowed the abstract's scope sentence to sparse GEMM and noted the dense results as future work in §7.

deferred.reason: Table 3 needs a baseline tuned at the evaluated shapes; the round's shape set is fixed by the harness, so this needs a re-run rather than an edit.

rejected.reason: The reviewer read §4.2's 'no library call' as excluding the reference path, which §4.2 explicitly permits two sentences later.
rejected.clarified: Moved the reference-path exception to the sentence that states the rule, so it cannot be read past.

incidental_changes: Fixed a broken \autoref in §5.1 found while fixing A1's surrounding text.
